workspace.label: Accessible name of the area that shows a Space's pages (product noun Space).
workspace.loading-page: Shown where a page will be while its text loads.
workspace.errors.load-pages: Error banner when the Space's list of pages couldn't load; it is tried again every few seconds.
workspace.errors.load-page: Error banner when the open page's text couldn't load; it is tried again every few seconds.
workspace.errors.create-page: Error banner when New page failed.
tabs.label: Accessible name of the row of tabs under a Space's name. {{space}} is the Space's name.
tabs.memory: Tab: what the Space's socios (AI agents) remember for everyone in it.
tabs.radar: Tab: a feed of what changed in the Space.
tabs.settings: Tab: who sees the Space, and its people.
library.label: Accessible name of a Space's page library. {{space}} is the Space's name.
library.new-folder: Button: opens the dialog that names a new folder in the level being browsed.
library.new-page: Button: makes a new, empty page in the level being browsed and opens it.
library.search: Placeholder and accessible name of the library's search box.
library.browse.label: Accessible name of the menu that picks how the library lists pages.
library.browse.level: Menu choice: one level of the page tree at a time, opened from its parent.
library.browse.all: Menu choice: every page at once, each with its path.
library.relevance: Shown where the sort menu is while searching: results come in order of how well they match.
library.sort.label: Accessible name of the sort menu.
library.sort.recent: Sort choice in a Space's page library: the most recently edited pages first.
library.sort.name: Sort choice: alphabetical by title.
library.view.label: Accessible name of the two buttons that show the pages as cards or rows.
library.view.grid: Button (an icon) that shows the library's pages as cards in a grid.
library.view.list: Button (an icon) that shows the library's pages as rows in a list.
library.trail.label: Accessible name of the path to the level being browsed (like a breadcrumb).
library.trail.top: Button in the path: back to the Space's top level.
library.trail.open-folder: Button at the end of the path: opens the folder itself rather than listing what is in it.
library.trail.open-page: Button at the end of the path: opens the page itself rather than listing the pages inside it.
library.heading.search: Heading over the search's results, followed by their count.
library.heading.all: Heading over every page of the Space, followed by their count.
library.heading.folder: Heading over what a folder holds, followed by the count.
library.heading.page: Heading over the pages inside a page, followed by the count.
library.heading.top: Heading over the Space's top level, followed by the count.
library.count: Accessible name of the number beside the heading; the screen shows only the digits. The _more forms are for a search with more results than shown (the screen shows "20+").
library.corrected: Over the search results when the search corrected a typo. {{words}} is the corrected search, shown bold; <words> marks it.
library.search-instead: Button after the correction: searches for exactly what the person typed ({{query}}).
library.empty-page: Where a page's card shows the start of its text, for a page with none.
library.searching: Heading of the library's results area while a search is running.
library.no-matches: Heading in the library when a search found no page.
library.inside: On a page's card: how many pages are inside it.
library.edited: On a page's card: when it was last edited. <time></time> is where the date shows (for example "Nov 3").
library.empty.folder: Heading in the library while browsing a folder that holds nothing.
library.empty.page: Heading in the library while browsing a page that has no pages inside it.
library.empty.none: Heading in the library of a Space that has no pages at all.
library.empty-hint.none: Under "No pages yet" in a new Space (product noun).
library.folder-line: Where a folder's card would show a page's text: how many pages and folders it holds.
library.empty-folder: On a folder's card, where a page's card shows the start of its text: the folder holds nothing.
library.parents: Accessible name of a card's line of parent page titles.
library.delete: Accessible name of a card's delete button. {{title}} is the page's title.
library.delete-title: Tooltip of a card's delete button.
dataset-menu.button: Button in a Space's library that opens the dataset menu (New dataset, Add existing dataset). A dataset is a table of data.
dataset-menu.new: Menu item in the library's dataset menu: makes a new dataset in the Space.
dataset-menu.existing: Menu item in the library's dataset menu: places a dataset the person already has in the Space.
